title: Nan: real sound effects
kaylee: Nan sounds real now: scooters and tuk-tuks whoosh past the Pajero, buffalo moo, the fire crackles, frogs and birds all around each stop.
questions: Any sound to redo? Name the stop and number (e.g. salt 4).
The background birds, breeze and village: keep, quieter, or off?
